Coordinate.description: A value the solver works out, in millimetres: a number, read correctly rounded to the nearest 64-bit float, and written in full as the shortest decimal that reads back as it. Within a kilometre of the origin.

request.description:
`drag_move`'s request: move the drag's cursor. It runs beside the session's queue, and
only the newest move is solved: one replaced before it's solved answers `dropped`. Send
moves only once `drag_begin` has answered.

session.description: The session's ID, as `open` gave it.

to.description: The cursor, `[x, y]` in the sketch's coordinates.

request.title: DragMoveRequest

Coordinate.description: A value the solver works out, in millimetres: a number, read correctly rounded to the nearest 64-bit float, and written in full as the shortest decimal that reads back as it. Within a kilometre of the origin.

ElementId.description: A sketch element's ID: 8 characters of Crockford's base32 in lower case (digits and letters but i, l, o, and u), unique within its sketch.

FrameEnd.description: How the frame ended: solved (the cursor solved for, the part's points and free radii given); failed (the solver didn't reach the cursor; the drag goes on); invalid (it reached geometry that can't be built); or dropped (a newer move replaced it before it was solved). Only solved gives values: otherwise keep the last frame.

FramePoint.description: A point of a drag's frame.

FrameRadius.description: A free radius of a drag's frame.

result.description:
`drag_move`'s result: a frame, a diagnostic, never a result (which moves are solved
depends on the worker's speed).

points.description: With solved, every point of the part the drag moves, by ID; otherwise empty.

radii.description:
With solved, each circle and arc of the part whose radius is free, by ID; otherwise
empty.

to.description: The cursor solved for, as the request gave it.

result.title: DragMoveResult
